text: Arjun lives in Headingley now, moved in with his sister Uma. He's still at the council, planning department.
housewarming at Zoe and Kai's next Saturday 7ish, bring a bottle. they finally got the keys to the place on Beech Road
Gareth from accounts is leaving on 2 November 2026, collection going round. need to put a tenner in before Friday

Just off the phone with Angela. Her mum's 70th is this weekend, they've booked a room at the Italian place. Angela sounds frazzled, she's doing the cake and the seating plan and her brother Hugo hasn't lifted a finger. Remind me to text her Sunday to see how it went.

Duc - works for Okafor Logistics, team lead on the warehouse side, been there about eight years. two kids (girls, 6 and 9), both at the primary on Otley Road. wife is Wei, she's a nurse at St James's, mostly nights. they live out in Horsforth near the park, his parents are just down the street and do a lot of the school runs
dinner at Fern's tomorrow, I'm bringing dessert

so um Kenji's boss asked him to present the client figures next Tuesday to the whole board and he's really nervous about it, he's never done anything that big, uh I should send him a good luck message Monday night
Caitlin's leaving do got cancelled, apparently she's staying on after all. Good news really.
Tendai: Zimbabwean, grew up in Bulawayo, moved here 2015. Lives in Didsbury with partner Xavier. Supporter of Arsenal for some reason
pick up dry cleaning, renew car tax before end of month
Tamar invited us to her engagement party in a fortnight. Zhang's doing the music. Don't forget to RSVP by Thursday

Long chat with Kerry over coffee. Her new manager is a nightmare apparently, micromanages everything, wants hourly updates and copies himself into every email. Two people on her team have already handed their notice in. She's thinking about applying elsewhere, maybe going back to the NHS, and she's got a call with a recruiter on Thursday. I should send her that job ad Gemma forwarded me.
Jack and Nadia are hosting Christmas dinner this year, 25 Dec obviously, said we can come. Their dog Biscuit will be there so warn Mum about the allergy thing
Abebe says the client meeting with Rossi & Co moved to next Wednesday. he's leading it
bumped into Andile at the station, she works at the uni library now, part-time. Her son Callum just started at Leeds Beckett
Leah's birthday drinks Friday at the Brewery Tap. She mentioned she's been eyeing up a new yoga mat, the cork ones
Mustafa said his dad had a fall last week, in hospital still. Ring Mustafa at the weekend to check in
Sana - vegetarian, doesn't drink, lives round the corner from the office. Sister Amara is a dentist in Bradford.

Oscar's retirement party is 14 March 2027 at the golf club, after 31 years at the firm. Gemma's organising, she wants everyone to chip in for a watch and she's after photos from the old office for a slideshow. Oscar has no idea about the slideshow. Dig out the ones from the 2019 away day and send them to Gemma by the end of February.
me tues: dentist 9am, then gym. weds wfh
Bridget told me at lunch she and her husband are splitting up. She's keeping the house. Seemed okay but tired. Must check in on her next week.
aisha's flat-warming saturday!! 8pm onwards, she said bring board games. her flatmate Kai is the one who does the cocktails

Just had a really long call with Hugo about work. He's been put on the Lopez account, which is the big retail client everyone hates, and his manager Callum keeps dumping extra stuff on him late on Fridays. He's knackered, thinking about asking for a transfer to the Manchester office. Told him to talk to HR. I need to follow up in a couple of weeks and see if he did.
Wei's parents live in Shenzhen, she flies out to see them every spring. Her brother Zhang lives in Vancouver
dinner party at Gareth & Uma's, Sat 21st. Oscar and Leah coming too. Gareth asked if I'd do a starter, so that's on me
note: Xavier Kowalski - new client contact, procurement, based in Warsaw. prefers email to calls
Callum's 40th surprise party is off, his wife found out he hates surprises lol. Doing a quiet meal instead next Friday
remind me to ask Fern how her interview at the hospital went, it was this morning
Zoe works three days a week at the garden centre, the rest at home with the twins. Her husband Duc is an electrician.
Mrs Hughes next door had her hip done Monday. Her daughter Bridget's staying with her for a fortnight. Pop round with some soup tomorrow
Arjun mentioned Sana's having a baby, due March 2027! Didn't know. Need to get a card
team drinks Thursday after work for Amara's promotion, she's now senior analyst. Book the table at the Swan
called Kerry back. her cat Pickle went missing two days ago, she's put posters up everywhere. really upset. text her tomorrow to see if there's any news

Tendai's work Christmas do is 12 December 2026 at some hotel in town and partners are invited so I'm going with him. Black tie. ugh. He says his boss Xavier will be giving a speech and there's a rumour the whole department is getting merged in the new year, so it might be a slightly tense evening. Need to get my suit taken in before then.
Spoke to Andile about the conference. She's speaking on Thursday the 5th, second slot after lunch. Asked me to send her the slides by Monday so she can check them

Abebe and his wife Kerry have a holiday cottage in the Lakes, near Keswick, they let it out most of the summer and go up themselves at New Year. Their son Jack is at uni in Durham, second year, studying law, and their daughter Leah is still at home doing her A levels. Abebe is originally from Addis, came over to do his masters.
Uncle Gareth's 60th is in a fortnight, Mum wants us all there. Need to get him something whisky related
leah said the agency is restructuring, half the creative team might go. she's worried. meeting with HR next tuesday
invite from Angela to her book club, first Wednesday of the month. Said I'd try it in November
oscar is a big cyclist, does the Etape every July. married to Gemma, no kids, two greyhounds
Kenji's wedding anniversary is 3 June, ten years in 2027 so a big one. Hugo says they're planning a trip to Japan for it
Nadia's off on maternity leave from Friday. Card going round reception. Sign it and put in for the hamper.
Grocery shop tonight. Book MOT for the week of 9 November 2026. Call the plumber about the boiler.
Aisha's back from Lagos, her grandma's funeral was last Saturday. She's back at work tomorrow but said she's not really okay. Bring her a coffee and see how she's doing
New starter in my team, Kai MacDonald, starts Monday. Ex-Deloitte, lives in Leeds, cycles in. I'm buddying him for the first month
Tamar's brother Mustafa got into the Royal College of Music!! Starts September 2027. She's so proud
Zhang's partner Caitlin is Irish, from Galway. They met at uni. Live in a flat in Shoreditch with way too many plants

Got invited to Duc's 30th, Saturday 15th, karaoke place in Chinatown. He wants everyone in 80s fancy dress. Wei (his girlfriend, not the other Wei) is organising, said message her if I need the address. Don't forget to buy a wig
Fern's manager Angela is going on long-term sick leave, back problems. Fern's acting up until at least Easter.
uma's leaving drinks were last night, she starts at the BBC on Monday. text her monday morning, good luck first day

Bridget Adeyemi from the Okafor account rang this afternoon to say the contract renewal is going to be delayed till January, maybe mid January. She's annoyed with her finance team, they keep losing the paperwork. She's also off for two weeks from Friday, her colleague Mustafa will cover. Let the boss know tomorrow and email Mustafa an intro.
Jack works nights at the hospital, so don't call before 2pm. Lives with his girlfriend Zoe in Chapel Allerton
Xavier's mum passed away in the summer. He mentioned it today for the first time, still clearly cut up about it

Voice memo. Okay so Arjun and Tamar are having a joint birthday barbecue next Sunday at Arjun's, weather permitting, if it rains they'll do it in the garage. Tamar said not to bring presents but she did say she's run out of that fancy gin she likes, so maybe. Also Arjun's brother Kenji is flying in from Tokyo for it which is nice.
Gemma - new receptionist, very chatty, lives in Pudsey with her mum. Has a son called Oscar too, which is confusing
hugo's band gig friday got called off, drummer broke his wrist
Amara told me Callum got the job at Rossi! Starts in the new year. Send congrats
Wei and Zhang have a dinner party Saturday 8pm, invited me and Nadia. They're doing hotpot. Nadia's coeliac so I said I'd mention it
quiet one tonight, nothing much happened. finish the book, early night

Sana had her driving test this morning, third attempt, was so nervous beforehand. Ask her how it went when I see her at Kerry's dinner on Friday. Kerry also said her mum's down from Aberdeen this weekend, staying till next Tuesday.
